verdict.rationale: Edge0 can run with no GUI. It ships an `edge0 serve` command exposing an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint reachable via curl, a one-shot chat CLI, a programmatic Python `AutoEngine` API, and an explicit macOS CLI/daemon mode. Unit tests run under pytest without real weights, which suits CI. missing for 10: explicit Linux/server-GPU deployment support (the CUDA backend is only a reserved slot), documented CI pipeline or container guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless server use.
